summary: Performs a bilinear 2D texture resample. Validates an object type tag (byte at +8 must equal 3), derives construction flags from tag bits 0x20000 and BYTE2 bit 0, builds X and Y interpolation coordinate tables via MemoryAllocation_53ec from the dimension pairs at dword indices 1046 and 1047, allocates two 16-byte staging buffers, iterates destination rows and columns, fetches source texels through vtable slot +4 and processes rows through vtable slot +8, applies weighted float interpolation using the coordinate blend factors, writes interpolated texels to the destination, frees the coordinate tables and staging buffers, and returns 0 on success or an HRESULT error code.

operations.description: SEHHandlerInit() installs the structured exception handler whose landing pad is loc_59C4DC.
Type-tag guard: the low byte of the object tag (v1[2]) must equal 3, otherwise return -2147467259.
Construction flags derived from the tag: bit 0x20000 selects the coordinate-table mode and BYTE2 bit 0 controls per-dimension behaviour.
MemoryAllocation_53ec builds the X and Y interpolation coordinate tables from the source/destination dimension pairs at dword indices 1046 and 1047.
If either coordinate table allocation returns null, execution jumps to cleanup and the function returns -2147024882.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(16 * width) allocates the first staging buffer of 16-byte vector elements.
sub_5008C2 initialises the staged vector elements using the element constructor sub_5007EC.
If the first staging buffer is null, execution jumps to cleanup returning -2147024882.
A second staging buffer of 32 bytes per element is allocated and element-constructed via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and sub_5008C2/sub_5007EC.
If the second staging buffer is null, execution jumps to cleanup returning -2147024882.
Nested do-while loops over the destination rows (index 1047) and columns (index 1046) resample every destination texel.
Source data is fetched through the vtable method at slot +4 and the per-row processing step is driven through the vtable method at slot +8.
Weighted float interpolation combines the coordinate-table blend factors with the four source texel channels (two x two bilinear taps).
The four interpolated float channels are written to the destination buffer element.
FreeWrapper_7bcf releases the two coordinate tables and the two staging buffers before returning.
Returns 0 on success, -2147467259 on tag mismatch, and -2147024882 when a table or staging allocation fails.
Invoked from D3DContextInit (005063a5) during Direct3D context initialisation.
